purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0150 in the gravity arena: the bulk mesh's own Green's function read on the husk, partial (the direct reflecting cross-check's residual missed its 1e-12 gate at 3.7e-11, 3e-14 of its value, the float floor), every physics gate as derived: the graph Laplacian's inverse on the true {3,4,3,4} mesh below a cusp falls exponentially along the husk, 3.07 to 3.11 a dock (0.0436, 1.93e-3, 8.58e-5, ... 7.9e-13 at r = 8), not as any power, because the husk is the top layer and a link at level l moves at most 1/l horizontally, so the bulk is a sink and not a shortcut: a massive brane mode of length 0.325 docks, which kills H3b (Newton's kernel) and I11a (a power-law spectrum), and the cubic pattern grows with distance (3.68 against 3.08 per unit length), which kills I12b; a reflecting floor gives 1/(4 pi K r) with K growing 1.19 a level (1, 6.00, 10.70, 20.23, 29.82 at floors 1 to 49), so a finite bulk's Newton coupling falls as one over its depth, and the four-level share 1/K = 0.167 is not E-GRV-0100's 0.549.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
